title: Curated Curriculum Module
description: A saved, reusable unit plan: an ordered selection of lessons from this repo, with optional review fragments attached. Consumed by the course hub (../Admin) to create Canvas modules.

name.description: Human-readable module name, e.g. "Computer Setup and Git Usage"

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match the filename: _modules/<slug>.json

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what this module covers

unit_number.description: Suggested unit number. The hub may override this at import time based on the target course's existing modules.

points_per_assignment.description: Base points per assignment, BEFORE unit scaling is applied

scale_factor.description: Per-unit point multiplier (points × scale_factor^unit_number, smart-rounded). Hub default is 1.15.

start_date.description: Almost always null — start dates belong to course scheduling at import time, not the curated module

topic_names.description: Top-level topic folders the lessons are drawn from, in the order they were added. Used by the hub to build the Canvas module name.

day.description: 1-indexed day within the unit (from the topic's LESSONS.md)

duration.description: Number of class periods this assignment spans (default 1)

duration_override.description: True when the teacher set this assignment's length in the Module Planner (the inline day-count dropdown), overriding the lesson's LESSONS.md duration. When absent, loading the module re-reads the duration from the repo.

path.description: Lesson folder name inside the topic folder, e.g. "RepositoriesAndCommits". Empty string for a placeholder entry (see "placeholder").

_module.description: Top-level topic folder the lesson lives in, e.g. "GitUsage". Named to match the hub's create-module payload. Empty string for a placeholder entry (see "placeholder").

placeholder.description: True for an "Additional Day" stub inserted from the Module Planner that doesn't reference a real lesson yet (path/_module are empty strings). Skipped by lesson-existence checks; excluded from Canvas assignment creation until it references a real lesson and this flag is removed.

kind.description: Optional flag on a placeholder entry. "page": Canvas sync creates an unpublished Page (linked into the module) instead of an assignment — an in-class day with no homework. "test": the day number is reserved for a manually placed test; nothing is created on sync. Absent: plain Additional Day (fill in later, nothing syncs).

review.description: Reference to a review fragment to prepend to this assignment. Stored as a reference (not inline content) so the repo stays the single source of truth — the hub resolves it to markdown at import time.

path.description: Lesson folder containing the review/ subfolder

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last edit
